name: The Abyssal Trench
body: Subterranean ocean trench featuring hydrothermal black smoker geysers, twilight sapphire strata, and abyssal basalt.

name: Center-Column Auto Ladder
body: Automatically deploys ladders in the exact center column of the mine (or sky) when blocks are mined.

name: Bouncing Ball Class
body: Specialist in chaotic kinetic sphere ordnance. Bouncy balls rebound off cavern walls before detonating across 15 mineral tiers.
Makes Tabbitha vacuum upgrades directly purchasable in the Bonus shop in addition to quest rewards, and adds Levels 5 to 8 (up to 600 tiles).

name: Chest Tier Variance
body: Dynamic chest tier variance, weighted class weapon seeding, and dangerous booby-trap explosions.

name: Chrono-Industrialist Class
body: Temporal excavation engineer wielding 15 tiers of chrono harvesters.

name: Collector Priority System
body: Configure Collector UFO target acquisition priority: Closest First vs Most Valuable Gem First.

name: Expanded Class Suite (9 Classes)
body: Complete 9-Class Suite: Knight, Jedi, Bouncing Demolitionist, Rainbow Sinclairity, Void Siphon, Debt Executioner, Chrono-Industrialist, Gravitational Dreadnought, and Tectonic Fracker.

name: Debt Executioner Class
body: Corporate enforcer starting at -$50M debt with 15 tiers of rotary miniguns.

name: Diagonal Seams Custom Map
body: 45-degree rotated diagonal subterranean strata and Sky Mine variants.

name: Donkey Kong Surface Hazard
body: Surface gorilla hazard patrols ground level and tosses rolling barrels down mine pits. 5-second stun on impact.

name: Quadcopter Drone Workforce Overhaul
body: Replaces all walking employee miners with hovering quadcopter laser drones and transforms UFO collectors into heavy-lift cargo quadcopters.
Adds secondary scaling multipliers (drill_speed, axe_speed, gun_rate) to give single-multiplier weapons quadratic late-game scaling.

name: Elemental Airstrikes Triad
body: Elemental Airstrike Triad: Dragon Strike (Fire), Water Bomber (Wetness), and Agent Orange Bomber (Poison).
When a tile with poison, fire or water effects is destroyed while still having ticks left, those effects spread to nearby ores in a configurable radius.

name: Expanded Employee Passives
body: Expanded employee passives: Employee Miner Range, Employee Miner Pickup Speed, and Collector Range.

name: End-Game Staffs & Poison Guns
body: Registers Tiers 12-15 End-Game Magic Staffs and all 15 Caustic Poison Guns into the shop.
Maintains a mining combo counter that buffs player movement, pickaxe speed, and triggers shockwaves.

name: Game Speed & Shift Finisher
body: Adjust game simulation speed (0.5x, 0.75x, 1.0x, 1.5x, 2.0x) via on-screen HUD or hotkeys ([ / ]), plus emergency day finish (F8).

name: Gravitational Dreadnought Class
body: Heavy armored fortress wielding 15 tiers of orbital cannons.
Adds 15 tiers of bouncing grenades that arc, rebound off solid walls, and detonate on timed fuses.

name: Hardware Multi-Thread Booster
body: Accelerates terrain generation and heavy calculations using Godot 4 WorkerThreadPool across multi-core CPUs.

name: Heavy Demolition Bombs
body: Heavy Demolition Bomb arsenal (Bunker Buster, Cryo-Cluster, Thermobaric) using native big bomb sprites.

name: Heavy Automated Turrets
body: Deployable automated heavy defense and mining turret utilizing unused tank_turret.png asset.

name: Henry the Hoover (Vacuum Reskin)
body: Authentic Henry the Hoover visual skin for the industrial vacuum. Body color dynamically updates based on upgrade tier (Henry, Hetty, Harry, George, Charles).
Adds 15 tiered Hydrogen Bombs spanning Shoddy to Onyx with massive blast radii for cavern excavation.
Adds the InfiniPlatform: builds a continuous bridge horizontally left and right across open gaps up to walls (max 200 blocks).

name: Jedi Class
body: Wielder of plasma energy sabers across 15 mineral tiers.

name: The Knight Class
body: Master of chivalric blade combat. Starts with a Shoddy Sword that sweeps in a 180° frontal arc cleaving rock and ore.

name: High-Energy Laser Beam
body: Continuous collimated high-energy laser beam weapon using native shader and audio assets.
Comprehensive all-time high scores and quest rewards leaderboard covering collectors, mortars, combat, and wealth.

name: The Living Canvas
body: Custom subterranean map sculpted directly from real images, photos, and Minecraft screenshots with an in-game file picker.

name: The Knight Class
body: Custom subterranean expedition map featuring unexploded ordnance and cryo-pod survivor rescue mechanics.
Extends Martial Artist with Mike Tyson, Jean-Claude Van Damme, and Chuck Norris moves and equipment.

name: COAL LLC UNIVERSAL MOD MANAGER
body: Comprehensive Mod Store featuring multi-repository filtering, live name and author searches, physical staging downloads, and integrated custom Title logo.
Settings compatibility bridge.

name: Cosmic Collectors
body: Adds 4 ultra-high-tier Collector drones with click-through tooltips.
Adds Tiers 5 through 10 of Drills with damage scaling from 100,000 up to 50 Billion, inserted directly after Drill 4.

name: Executive Miners
body: Adds Executive Miner tiers with click-through tooltips and scaled position offsets.
Adds Tiers 4 through 10 of inventory slot expansions with exponentially scaling capacities (+20 to +250 slots) and prices, inserted directly after Slot 3.
Adds Tiers 7 through 16 of inventory stack upgrades, scaling from 75 Trillion up to 50 Septillion, inserted directly adjacent to Stack 6.
Adds Shift Rock Layers 6 to 12 with dynamic stratum progression past vanilla limits.
Adds Tiers 6 through 10 of Mortar Guns with damage scaling from 7.5 Million up to 500 Billion, inserted directly after Mortar Gun 5.
Adds 15 tiered Tactical Nukes spanning Shoddy to Onyx with balanced blast radius and damage.
Extends Tabatha's NPC questline past Diamond with Uranium, Moonstone, Onyx, and Abyssal vacuum upgrades.
Multi-save slot manager with career progression restore and fullscreen pre-run mod selector.
Adds 15 tiered Neutron Bombs spanning Shoddy to Onyx with extreme kinetic yield for shattering bedrock.
Equips the miner with an experimental high-energy Plasma Raygun on Right-Click that pierces multiple subterranean strata in a collimated beam.
When a tile with poison, fire or water effects is destroyed while still having ticks left, those effects spread to nearby ores in a configurable radius.

name: Expanded Interaction & Collection Reach
body: Subtly expands the player's interaction and collection reach by 1 tile. Pick up ore, deposit at the stockpile, and converse with NPCs (like Tabatha the Mermaid) from further away. Appears as a rare, non-exponential upgrade in the bonus shop.

name: Daytime Scrap & Amazon Delivery
body: Sell items during daytime shifts for 50% scrap value, and order same-day Amazon emergency supply drops with 10s delivery.
When a tile with poison, fire or water effects is destroyed while still having ticks left, those effects spread to nearby ores in a configurable radius.

name: Rainbow Sinclairity Class
body: Experimental spectral optics miner with continuous prismatic beam across 15 tiers.
Adds 45 tiered Incendiary, Caustic, and Depleted Uranium tanks to the shop, hooks chest drops for fire/poison passives, and enables dynamic passive scaling.

name: Tectonic Faultline
body: Custom subterranean faultline map with active magma strata and high-pressure magma siphons.

name: The Tectonic Fracker Class
body: Industrial seismic harvester. Fires acoustic fracture pulses that shatter entire continuous ore seams simultaneously across 15 mineral tiers.

name: Teletubbies & Noo-Noo Overhaul
body: Transforms your mine into Teletubbyland: Noo-Noo vacuum cleaner, yawning Baby Sun that sets with the timer, and colorful workforce reskins.

name: Thomas the Tank Engine Railway Class
body: Playable railway overhaul: Thomas shuttles back and forth along the mine floor between buffer stops, collecting ore into rolling wagons. Features 3-tier upgrade branches: Locomotives (Thomas, Edward, Henry, Gordon), Wagon Rake Count (1-6), and Hopper Capacity.

name: Elemental Tick Upgrades
body: Elemental tick upgrade rate engine. Based on der_floh's tick upgrade mod, enhanced for custom classes and modern ModLoader compatibility.
Collectors depot at the vacuum nozzle when it is closer than the surface chest.

name: Void Siphon Class
body: Gravitational singularity harvester with 15 tiers of void cores and implosion mechanics.
Orbital Water Spirit that circles the player and saturates surrounding rock tiles, scaling in radius and brush coverage with price.
Multiplies miniguns and water guns based on stack count (forward-only trajectory).
Automatically open chests and choose passives
